subject: Implement execution brain memory seam with verified session claim
description: Implement the local/live execution state versus git-synced durable claim seam. This retry must first prove the Codex edit gate sees the worker's active claim before editing: branch_task, determine the real hook session id, start_task with that session id, bind /overlay/claim-session, verify /active-claim?session=<sid> returns the task, then edit only inside the attempt worktree. Required behavior: keep live agent/session/workspace state local; make git claims durable/advisory by default with strict opt-in; add local overlay diagnostics for git claim audit; update config claim_mode validation; update git-claim tests.
